extensions.description: Make tasks and content perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust for the intended audiences.
Scope and evaluate a model capability, including its tools, errors, costs, and human fallback.
Connect a hypothesis, instrumentation, and analysis method to a measurable decision.
Define and verify an API boundary, including identities, errors, retries, and versions.
Ensure consistent server behavior across success, failure, concurrency, and recovery.
Prepare useful public updates about project progress, evidence, lessons, and limitations.
Build a stable command-line interface for people and automation.
Design reproducible cloud resources with access controls, recovery, health, and cost considerations.
Help people understand and complete their task through clear content in the right context.
Prepare diagnosis, assistance, and escalation for problems users actually encounter.
Make data flows traceable, replayable, and verifiable from source to consumer.
Preserve invariants, compatibility, performance, and recovery when changing persisted data.
Evolve shared primitives and components with their usage guidance, contracts, and migrations.
Verify a desktop application across windows, processes, files, permissions, and packaging.
Make the build and delivery path reproducible, observable, and recoverable.
Build rendered web behavior, including states, data, accessibility, and performance.
Build and verify a mobile experience across its lifecycle, network, permissions, and distribution.
Bound personal data processing through purpose, minimization, access, retention, and rights.
Connect the problem, audience, value, alternatives, and tradeoffs to a product decision.
Choose checks that reduce actual risks and link their results to acceptance criteria.
Prepare an identifiable release with compatibility, artifacts, release notes, and recovery.
Reduce abuse risks affecting assets and trust boundaries touched by the change.
Make public content discoverable and indexable according to its purpose and constraints.
Connect user-perceived reliability, indicators, objectives, alerts, and responses to degradation.
Connect intent, a supportable promise, messaging, and consistent narrative across product surfaces.
Reduce uncertainty about people, their tasks, and their context through proportionate observation.
Design journeys, interactions, states, and recovery for a user task.
Define appropriate hierarchy, readability, colors, typography, spacing, and visual states.
